images.name: day
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game background, 2172 x 724, stylized painterly 3D-render look. Input 1 Kyoto is the composition and camera reference ONLY. Input 2 lab is the art style, palette and props reference ONLY. Rebuild the lab using the Kyoto veranda composition.
Camera: seated viewer at eye level, horizon 48% up from bottom. Curved cylindrical 270-degree wide-angle panorama with a dominant single vanishing point in dead centre. Ceiling beams, pipes and cable trays overhead and floor tile lines and grates below converge strongly toward centre, gently curving like Kyoto roof beams and floorboards. No fisheye bulge at top or bottom.
Layout: viewer sits on raised observation deck inside biohazard containment lab. Two thick teal-and-white support pillars left and right of centre frame a broad open centre view, like Kyoto wooden posts. Through opening, about 10 metres away in a large deep open containment hall, a SMALL perfectly centred containment machine stands: glass dome full of glowing green envelope shapes, amber beacon on top, dark front hatch just below horizon. Machine must be distant and modest in frame, not a large foreground hero. Far wall soft, hazy and lower contrast.
Foreground deck floor is EMPTY and clean polished tiles reflecting lights. No table, bench or props in near centre. Open unobstructed air between viewer and machine. Preserve Kyoto's spacious foreground floor and broad open middle.
Sides: long left and right corridors recede into depth, lined with lab windows, glowing green specimen tanks, shelves of jars, fume hood and small amber wall lamps, analogous to Kyoto shoji rooms. Busy detail stays at far lateral edges. Calm readable centre.
Lighting: bright clinical ceiling lights on, cool teal and white, toxic green tank and machine glows, warm amber wall lamp accents. Centre opening brightest and inviting, soft atmospheric haze in far hall.
No people, no text, no letters or UI, no characters, no vignette, no weapons. Envelope shapes are pictorial envelopes, no writing. Single full-bleed panorama.

images.name: night
images.prompt: Use the attached image as the edit base, so layout is identical. Same camera, composition and every object in exactly the same place. Only the lighting changes: ceiling lights are OFF and the hall is dark. Scene lit only by toxic green glows from tanks, the machine's dome and hatch, amber wall lamps and amber beacon, with deep teal shadows, green reflections on the polished wet-looking floor, darker moodier haze in far hall. Preserve exact small distant machine, envelope arrangement, open empty foreground, paired pillars, rails, floor seams, pipes, all side corridor props and framing. All white/cyan ceiling fixtures must be unlit dark housings, not glowing. Atmospheric night with readable silhouettes and inviting green central focal point. Same stylized painterly 3D art, ultra-wide 3:1 panorama, 2172 x 724. No new props, text, UI, people, weapons, vignette or camera change.
